en: Black‑and‑white printed postcard showing a detailed bird's‑eye view drawing of a large industrial factory complex with multiple long brick buildings, tall chimneys emitting smoke, internal roads, and some smaller houses or offices at the front. A tree‑lined embankment runs along a river in the foreground where a small steamship is depicted. Below the image there is a German caption identifying the factory and its date.
